highlights.title: Design Center specs, fast
highlights.desc: Open RAML, OAS and AsyncAPI projects of any size in seconds. Every edit is checked by AMF, the engine Design Center uses, so errors show as you type. Suggestions for types, traits and !include paths are instant, and Design Center's shelf sits under the editor.

highlights.title: Forms and code in step
highlights.desc: Build a new API from the forms, as with Design Center's Guide me through it, or edit any spec with them: resources, methods, types, parameters, security schemes and responses for RAML 1.0 and OAS 3.0 and 3.1, and servers, channels, messages and schemas for AsyncAPI. Switch between forms and code any time, and a form changes only the lines it must. Or start from a secured starter that passes MuleSoft's best-practice and OWASP security rulesets. Check a sample body against any type, and copy an OAS schema as a RAML type. Rename a type everywhere, find its uses, extract to a library, or delete with cascade.

highlights.title: Design Center and Exchange
highlights.desc: Sign in with Anypoint, pull your projects, push with the branch lock, work on branches and merge with conflict help. Publish to Exchange with a suggested version, manage Exchange dependencies, and see what changed since the last version. Connections start read only.

highlights.title: Governance, docs and a local mock
highlights.desc: Check your API against the rulesets it depends on. Read it as documentation, try any method on a local mock that answers like Design Center's, and see every type's uses on the API map.

highlights.title: AI tools (MCP)
highlights.desc: Let agents like Claude, Copilot and Cursor work in Design Studio: open projects, edit specs, run AMF's checks and governance, try the mock and work with Design Center, while you watch every change. Changes in Design Center and Exchange stay off until you allow them.

highlights.title: API Design Academy
highlights.desc: 46 lessons, from how computers talk (HTTP, JSON, integration, MuleSoft) to all of RAML (types, resource types, traits, security schemes, fragments, libraries), Design Center, Exchange, APIkit and API Manager, with exam-style practice for the MuleSoft Developer I and II certifications. Every lesson has something to try or answer, and AMF checks what you write.

highlights.title: Also in VS Code
highlights.desc: The same app in an editor tab. Right-click a project folder or a .raml file and pick Open in Design Studio. Copilot's agent mode can use Design Studio's AI tools directly, with nothing to set up or start.
